# SpaceAutoBattler

> Deterministic 3D space auto-battler: simulation logic (deterministic AI & physics) is separated from rendering and UI. This repository contains the simulation core, renderer, configuration, tests, build scripts, and developer guides needed to run, test, and extend the project.

A concise navigation guide optimized for LLMs and contributors. Focus areas: pure simulation core under `src/`, configuration-driven behavior in `src/config/`, deterministic RNG and canonical `GameState` types, and fast unit tests in `test/vitest/`. Use docs/ and spec/ for design and architecture details, and memory/ for ongoing project context.

## Documentation

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, quickstart, development commands, and high-level architecture.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Repository contribution and agent guidelines (rules for automated edits).

- [memory/activeContext.md](memory/activeContext.md): Current short-lived project context and decisions.

## Key source locations (core code)

- [src/](src/): Top-level source folder (TypeScript).
- [src/core/](src/core/): Simulation core  entity management, AI, pure game logic. Primary area for logic changes.
- [src/types/](src/types/): Canonical types including `GameState` used across the codebase.
- [src/config/](src/config/): All balance & runtime configuration (entities, behavior, physics, renderer). Prefer config changes over code when tuning.
- [src/utils/](src/utils/): Utilities including deterministic RNG (`src/utils/rng.ts`) and vector math.
- [src/main.ts](src/main.ts): App entry and main loop (wiring between sim/renderer).
- [src/simWorker.ts](src/simWorker.ts): Physics worker (Rapier3D) and sim  main thread messaging.

## Tests & validation

- [test/](test/): Test harness and fixtures.
- [test/vitest/](test/vitest/): Unit tests (Vitest). Primary validation for simulation logic.
- [vitest.config.js](vitest.config.js): Vitest configuration.
- Typecheck: `npm run typecheck` (npx tsc --noEmit)
- Tests: `npm test` (run unit test suite)

## Build, run, and tooling

- [package.json](package.json): Scripts (build, test, serve) and dependency manifest.
- [scripts/](scripts/): Helper scripts used during development (generators, validators).
- [webpack.config.mjs](webpack.config.mjs): Bundler config for builds.
- [playwright.config.cjs](playwright.config.cjs): Playwright config (no authored E2E tests by default).
- Build: `npm run build` and `npm run build-standalone`
- Serve: `npm run serve` / `npm run serve:dist`

- [src/config/rendererConfig.ts](src/config/rendererConfig.ts): Visual and camera settings.
- [src/config/entitiesConfig.ts](src/config/entitiesConfig.ts): Ship classes, turrets, health, damage parameters.
- [assets/](assets/): Textures, shaders, and other visual assets.
- [SHIP_INSTANCING.md](SHIP_INSTANCING.md): Notes about ship instancing strategy.

## Quick guidance for LLMs and contributors

- Edit only TypeScript under `src/`  do not modify generated artifacts in `dist/`.
- All runtime state must live on the canonical `GameState` type from `src/types/`.
- Preserve determinism: use the seeded RNG in `src/utils/rng.ts` for simulation flows.
- Prefer configuration changes in `src/config/` for tuning balance or behavior.
- Tests are fast and deterministic: run `npm test` and `npm run typecheck` before commits.
- For visual/renderer work, follow asset pooling and Three.js disposal patterns in `src/renderer/` and `memory/renderer-*` docs.
